documents.title: Unaudited Standalone Financial Results For Quarter Ended 30Th June, 2026.

analysis.summary: One Global Service Provider Limited released its 33rd Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting strategic transformation, expansion into IT consultancy and software solutions alongside its core life sciences and healthcare offerings. The company reported total revenue of Rs. 14,784.17 lakhs and a net profit of Rs. 1,846.66 lakhs for the year. Management noted that the financial figures for the year ended March 31, 2025, reflect the amalgamation of Plus Care Internationals Private Limited with the company.

guidance.claim: Management stated that while the initial performance of the newly entered IT consultancy and software solutions business is not remarkable, they are sure the company will grow and achieve success in the market.
guidance.quote: In the beginning phase, the performance of the Company is not remarkable but I am sure we will grow and achieve the success the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that recognizing evolving market needs, the business objectives were recently expanded to include IT Consultancy and Software Solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Recognizing the evolving needs of the market, we have recently expanded our business objectives to include IT Consultancy and Software Solutions.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that the initial performance in the new IT segment is modest.
demand_outlook.quote: While our initial performance in this new segment is modest, we are confident that with perseverance, innovation, and strategic partnerships, we will achieve sustainable growth and market success.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently expanded its object and entered the IT consultancy and software solutions industry.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has recently expanded its Object and also entered in the industry of IT Consultancy and Software Solutions provider.

capex_expansion.claim: Pluscare Internationals Private Limited is planning to get merged with the company and relevant documents have been filed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
capex_expansion.quote: *Pluscare Internationals Private Limited is planning to get merged with the company and the company has filed documents on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company confirmed that no deposits were accepted from the public during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not accepted any deposits from the public within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 1 per equity share of Rs. 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on the Company’s performance, the Board recommended a dividend of ` Rs. 1 per share on 71,04,707 equity shares of ` 10 each, subject to the approval of the Members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of the Company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of the Company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: There has been no transfers to the General Reserve of the Company for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: There has been no transfers to the General Reserve of the Company for the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: The secretarial auditor observed that the company failed to fill the vacancy in the office of Chief Financial Officer within the stipulated time.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, the Company failed to appoint Chief Financial Officer within the stipulated time as per Regulation 26A(2) of SEBI LODR.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that physical share folios unverified by December 31, 2025 will be referred to the administering authority under the Benami Transactions Act or Prevention of Money Laundering Act.
management_commitments.quote: If the securities continue to remain frozen as on December 31, 2025, the Company shall refer such securities to the administering authority under the Benami Transactions (Prohibitions) Act, 1988, and / or the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
